title: Times: Trump hates Zelensky after the impeachment in 2019
text:
US President Donald Trump is hostile to Ukraine and Vladimir Zelensky since the president's first time. About this writing time.
The publication has attracted attention to the fact that in recent days, Trump and Zelensky's relationships have become worse. Specifically, the US president accused Zelensky that began a conflict in Ukraine, and was called Islamic dictator, showing that he was addictive for financial benefits.
Trump's hostility related to Zelensky and Ukraine can be searched since his first period in the White House, the text said.
The US Finance Minister announced the breakdown of transactions with Kyiv
Times recalled that in 2019, the US president was mandatory due to the effort to use the Ukrainian government, to compromise with his main opponent at Joe Biden. In addition, the publication has been made a statement of Leo Parnassus, convicted in the United States for fraud and illegal sponsorship of election companies, former mayor and Trump lawyer, which statement That a year ago, the current US chapter hated Ukraine and considered it a reason for all his problems.
